title: Atlas Deaths
description: This Plugin brings a new way of dying in Minecraft, If you die you get given a challenge to complete and the whole server can see what challenge you have been given. all challenges are customizable and you can add as many as you'd like.
body:
# AtlasDeaths

AtlasDeaths introduces a new way of handling death in Minecraft. When a player dies, they are given a random challenge to complete. The entire server can see the challenge, creating fun, competitive, and sometimes chaotic gameplay.

All challenges are fully customizable and you can add as many as you want.

---

## Features

- Random challenges assigned on player death  
- Server-wide challenge announcements  
- Player screen challenge display  
- Fully customizable challenge list  
- Tracks total player deaths  
- Configurable messages and formatting  
- Supports unlimited challenges  

---

## Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|--------|------------|------------|
| `/help` | Show all commands | `atlasdeaths.help` |
| `/reloadconfig` | Reload config files | `atlasdeaths.reloadconfig` |

---

## How It Works

- When a player dies, they are assigned a random challenge  
- The challenge is shown on their screen  
- The server receives a broadcast with the player's challenge  
- Players must complete the challenge as part of gameplay  

This adds a risk and reward system to death and encourages interaction between players.

---

## Example Challenges

- Delete all diamond items from your inventory  
- No food for 20 minutes  
- Use only wooden tools for 1 hour  
- Drop your inventory and survive one night  
- Build a structure or complete a task  
- Let another player take items from your base  

You can fully edit or replace these with your own challenges.

---

## Configuration

Everything is configurable through YAML files:

- Challenge list  
- Player screen messages  
- Broadcast messages  
- Death tracking  
- Formatting and colors  

You can easily expand the system by adding more challenges.

---

## Additional Features

- Title message shown to players on death  
- Broadcast system for server announcements  
- Update notifications for new versions  
- Placeholder support  

---

## Dependencies

- PlaceholderAPI  
- bStats  

---

## Notes

- Designed for SMP servers but works on any server type  
- Challenges are purely configurable and expandable  
- Encourages player interaction and unique gameplay  

---

## Support

For help or suggestions, join the Discord:  
https://discord.gg/f9swPR7NnV

---

AtlasDeaths adds a fun and challenging twist to dying, turning every death into a new objective.
